title: Graphiti: Bi-Temporal Edge Timelines, Future-Tense Clamping & Contradiction Invalidation
summary: Graphiti tracks dual temporal coordinates per EntityEdge: transaction ingestion (created_at, expired_at) and real-world validity (valid_at, invalid_at). normalize_future_temporal_bounds() detects planned or scheduled assertions via _FUTURE_ASSERTION_RE, clamps valid_at > reference_time to reference_time, and clears false invalid_at values caused by soft deadlines (_DEADLINE_RE without _ONGOING_STATE_END_RE). resolve_edge_contradictions() sets invalid_at = new_edge.valid_at and expired_at = utc_now().

references.description: Bi-temporal resolve_edge_contradictions invalidating superseded edges with valid_at/expired_at

author: repo-triad-forge
distilled_learning: Track transaction vs event timelines separately, clamp future assertion start dates to statement reference time while ignoring soft deadlines, and expire contradicted facts deterministically.
